title: Azusawa Kohane — Midnight Making〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Kohane.
KAITO and Rin are hanging out back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Kohane, we've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's have another great day of songwriting!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm really looking forward to working with you two again, Rin, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to be so formal with us. Let's try to have fun while we work, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, did you get a chance to try your hand at some sampling?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I decided to use An's song as the base and tried a few different things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I couldn't really tell if it turned out okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, would you mind listening to it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-How was it...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought it was good!
You came up with some very interesting phrases for this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means we can get down to nuts and bolts!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I'm still a little worried about the phrase and things I used...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, are you concerned that you didn't do them justice?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I really don't think there's anything to worry about. I mean, there's no real right answer when it comes to sampling...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ugh. KAITO, don't kid around!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane's being serious, so you should be giving her concerns more consideration.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. I thought I was being serious.
At least, more than when I teach you and the others, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! Hang on! What's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Whoa, I was just kidding!
Please don't shake me like that! I'm going to get nauseous!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Rin...!
P-Please, calm down...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
KAITO, Rin, knock it off.
You're upsetting Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But KAITO was all...!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Rin, Kohane, here are your drinks.
KAITO, you don't get one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, but...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I finally got to have some coffee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I sort of can't do without it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Kohane, what did you feel during your attempt at sampling?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I started by listening to An's song and wanted to capture that heart-pounding sensation I felt when I heard it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I like it so much that I ended up using almost all of it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, almost all of it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, but that sort of defeats the purpose of this exercise, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I listened to it over and over again, and chose all the parts that I thought were absolutely necessary. That's what I had you listen to just now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. It sounds like you had quite a lot of fun with this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's the case, Kohane, I think you're doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...? I am...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Remember our discussion about songwriters being very meticulous creatures?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what do you think it means to be “meticulous”?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's simple!
You just have to have a clear image of what you want to do in your mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's all?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I definitely got the sense that you firmly know what you want to do, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The truth is... What I felt when I met An for the first time, my desire to thank her for inviting me to form a team, the joy I feel just standing next to her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
She's given me so much.
I want to convey just how exciting things have been for me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, that's great!
I can't wait to hear that song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me neither. I'll definitely want to hear it as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, Kohane, keep in mind that your feelings and the song you want to create lay within you and only you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thus, it's up to you to give it form and bring it into this world.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Within me only...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're right. I made the decision to do this, so I'm going to go through with it! I have to push my worries aside!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, KAITO, Rin, I'm going to try my best! And I'll be looking forward to working with you two!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! Kohane's so fired up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, she is. And don't forget to have fun along the way as you take on this new challenge.
